items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, also known as StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated remote code execution due to improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses CVE-2026-75650, a critical vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution and is being actively exploited. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix immediately.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin.
